handoffs.message: Auto-reassigned DATASTRAT-MARKETDATA-TW-FINMIND-004 away from unavailable lane Codex2 (disabled, sidecar-only, or auth-down); reviewer Codex2 -> Codex.

FinMind live fetcher implemented. PR #1297 open waiting for CI + auto-merge. Review: FinMindLiveFetcher (env token, credential_status, fetch_dataset/broker_report/storage_objects), _extract_quota_meta (rate-limit headers), build_finmind_fetch_plan (archive gets price-only, chip+news+broker skipped). 253 tests pass. Token never stored in records/logs.

PR #1297 merged to dev. Review scope: FinMindLiveFetcher (real HTTP fetch, env:// secret-ref, credential_status health, token redaction), _extract_quota_meta (rate-limit/quota header capture from live responses), build_finmind_fetch_plan (active-universe fanout - archive gets TaiwanStockPrice only, chip/news/broker top20 skipped). 21 new tests, 253 total pass. Token never stored in evidence/logs.

Review blocked: FinMindLiveFetcher authenticates by putting FINMIND_API_TOKEN in query URLs and does not send Authorization: Bearer; current FinMind OpenAPI/llms-full document Bearer auth for /data and dedicated endpoints, and tests currently assert token-in-URL behavior. Also fetch_storage_objects expects JSON via _get(), but current FinMind storage_objects docs/examples return whole-day parquet bytes; this will fail live SponsorPro backfill and may truncate ~22MB responses. Fix auth/header + binary/parquet handling and update tests.
Helper-claimed by Codex2 while Claude2 is dispatch-paused.

PR #1310 ready for review: FinMind live fetcher now uses Authorization header token handling, provider-owned adapter execution is covered, handoff artifact added, validation 293 passed/1 skipped on latest dev.
